digest/blake2#

BLAKE2 digests (RFC 7693), plain and keyed.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let digest = Blake2b(length: 32, origin: data).bytes();
let tag = Blake2bMac(key: secret, origin: message).bytes();

Description#

BLAKE2 digests (RFC 7693), plain and keyed.

Blake2b gives 16, 20, 28, 32, 48 or 64 bytes, Blake2s 16, 20, 28 or 32; the length is a parameter of BLAKE2, not a truncation. The keyed forms give full width (64 or 32 bytes) and take a SecretBytes key of 1 to 64 or 1 to 32 bytes.
